$comment: Timing, music and chapters of the marketing videos, read by src/data.ts and scripts/prepare-assets.mjs (music cut to the same timeline). Lengths in beats of the song (94.15 BPM: 19.12 frames a beat at 30 fps; every cut lands on the nearest frame of a beat). glyph: the brush character of a chapter card (simplified Chinese: the brush font has no traditional forms). pictures: a name is a scene of one picture, a list of names a scene of several pictures of one feature (cards coming to the front in turn).

music.$comment: A loop of 128 beats (81.7 s) played whole, no cut: intro (soft, beats 0-14), the chapters (beats 14-118: every card and picture on 2 mod 4, where the drum hits are), the end card on the last chord (118-128). Beat 0 at firstBeat seconds (onset analysis). accents: the big drum hits (beats of the song), where a gust of petals crosses the screen. A video longer than the song: the middle of main played again (cut on 2 mod 4); the accents follow the pieces (src/data.ts).
music.credit: Music: "Chinese Oriental Asian Love Music Loop" by Dvir Silverstone (Pixabay)
